_doc: Bottle hermit surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act1/bottle_hermit.md): glass is the salt-frosted lamp chimney lit from inside by the crab's own sea_glow (not glimmer), rough where the salt frost is and glossy where it is clear (the vertex wetness); metal the green-bronze collar, the brass seat, rivets and barnacles; chitin the crab, the weed and the weak point's small closed mark (its spawn_wound glow from the mask); eye the faceted eye caps. Polish: chitin is dry, weathered shell, not a wet toy (roughness 0.86 dry / 0.42 wet, specular 0.3, clearcoat 0.15, detail albedo 0.2 and bump 0.6; was 0.62 / 0.22 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.12 / 0.45): the vertex wetness keeps the top dry and the lower parts damp. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
